content: TypeScript strict migration on existing Vite+React codebase: enabling strict:true plus noUncheckedIndexedAccess at once is viable when the codebase is small/already well-typed (produces few errors). Fallback for larger codebases: per-directory tsconfig overrides, or enable strict sub-flags one at a time ordered by fewest resulting errors, or a pre-commit hook enforcing strict only on touched files.
